contract.thresholds: fixed Iref=max authored star I per event; per-star authored envelope I>=.01/.1 Iref; not per-frame maximum, not display threshold
contract.mainPhase: E10..E90 of eligible physical-head emitter I-time integral before head/tail partition; operational width=max D_I10 inside this interval while total I>=.1 sampled total peak
contract.lightUnits: authored reference cd and sum cd; physical-emitter proxy before head/tail partition, not rendered head-core-only intensity, total lumens, absolute calibrated radiometry or unknown-exposure-photo estimate
contract.scale: constant initial velocity deviations around root mean scaled; child velocityDelta scaled; rocket/common velocity/gravity/lifetime/I/RNG retained; no position scaling
contract.diameters: head centres: exact pairwise3D diameter and XZ diameter at stated sample times; all-born includes expired/underground diagnostic trajectories
contract.timeSampling: nonstrobe .05s,strobe1/120s plus event birth/ignition milestones; separate finer-grid diagnostic, not certified continuous maxima

checks.name: 160 research cases cover ten current production types,4 baseline seeds and two scales on2 seeds
diameter/threshold nesting and finite nonnegative source metrics
s1 is exact factory identity and candidates preserve physical source/timing/random fields
authoring scale preserves root mean velocity and scales common-age early geometry, not gravity
80degree air rise stays at reference under all seeds/scales/horizontal winds
wind is not removed by faking world positions or intensity
uniform smiley cohort retains width under5m/s wind after common translation
production sources unchanged and tail closure identical during study
main+full mirror needs no smaller fit than direct/island and no larger island on screen

limits: Unbounded persistent smoke/cloud delta excluded; they are being integrated separately.
No runtime candidate selected or GPU/photographic acceptance implied.
Ground effects phase0 means launch, not an aerial burst; no fake calibre width assigned.

Source-head emitter signals and actual head+tail CPU record ledger are separate; per-record threshold would depend on tail segmentation. Neither is a shutter-integrated GPU pixel brightness measurement.
D3D is not camera projected diameter; pixel contract must use fixed world orientation/view/focal/time and actual reflection.
Velocity dispersion changes kinetic energy/vertical extrema; preserved mean velocity is not a claim of measured star masses/momentum.
Finite sampling and source support bounds remain explicit; supplier product width does not specify this operational time/threshold convention.
